lessons.title: Separable 1st-order ODE, worked on (2-x)y' - 3y = 0
lessons.statement_latex: g(y)\frac{dy}{dx} = f(x) \iff g(y)\,dy = f(x)\,dx \implies \int g(y)\,dy = \int f(x)\,dx \implies G(y) = F(x) + c,\ c \in \mathbb{R}
